name: Vinyas Innovative Technologies Ltd.
summary: Vinyas Innovative Technologies Ltd. is an India-based integrated electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider. The company specializes in offering design, engineering, and electronics manufacturing services to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs) across various industries. Its core services include printed circuit board (PCB) assembly, cable harness assembly, and system integration, along with advanced test solutions, product integration, and box build assemblies. Vinyas Innovative Technologies operates on both build-to-print (B2P) and build-to-specification (B2S) models, focusing on high-reliability, high-complexity, and low-to-medium volume manufacturing for mission-critical applications. The company primarily serves the aerospace and defense, medical, automotive, telecommunication, consumer, and industrial sectors.
